Describes Tenzing Medical's mission to guide healthcare institutions toward better IT choices. Founded from Oroville Hospital's VistA implementation. Located in Oroville, CA.

Detailed case study of Oroville Hospital's VistA implementation. 133-bed acute care facility, $10M implementation cost, FOSS stack on Linux with YottaDB. Custom GUI scheduling package, pediatric support additions, disaster recovery with LMS configuration.

Details on eRx VistA ePrescribing module: Surescripts integration, drug interaction checking, medication history, formulary checking, pharmacy routing. Developed by consultant George Lilly in 2009, deployed Sep 2010, expanded to 15 clinics.

Oroville Hospital's EHR Development Office details. Custom applications: patient dashboard, pediatric growth chart, flow sheets, bed control, HealtheMe patient portal integration. CPOE modules: ADT interface, Sunquest lab interface, VistA Imaging, pharmacy customization. Development cost under $7M.
Oroville Hospital leadership page. Robert J. Wentz is CEO and co-founder of Tenzing Medical concept.

CPRS integrates VistA modules for Pharmacy, Lab, Radiology, Allergy Tracking, Consults, Dietetics, Progress Notes, Problem List, Scheduling, ADT, Vitals, PCE, TIU. Cover sheet displays active problems, allergies, medications, lab results, vital signs, hospitalization history.

Complete list of 85 VistA applications/modules including Adverse Reaction Tracking, Consult/Request Tracking, Controlled Substances, Dental, Dietetics, Discharge Summary, Drug Accountability, Inpatient Medications, Integrated Billing, Lab Service, Mental Health, Nursing Service, Oncology, Order Entry, Outpatient Pharmacy, Problem List, Progress Notes, Prosthetics, Radiology, Registration, Scheduling, Social Work, Surgery, Women's Health, and many more.

VistA EHR overview: CPOE, laboratory management, e-prescribing, diet orders, patient demographics, visit info, immunization/allergy tracking, vital signs, imaging, scheduling, patient portal, document management.
WorldVistA describes VistA as supporting large variety of clinical settings from small outpatient clinics to large medical centers. References VistA Non-EHR Modules as separate category.
Tenzing VistA 2.0 SED (Safety-Enhanced Design) usability test report. PDF could not be parsed but covers Clinical Decision Support and related criteria testing.
Oroville Hospital patient portal page. Currently uses Bridge Patient Portal for patient access to medical records.

Valley Clinical Laboratory at Oroville Hospital: full-service lab including clinical chemistry, special chemistry, microbiology, anatomic pathology, serology, hematology, urinalysis, blood banking, and cytology.
